tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan rig ral pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phas rgol me tog mda' yi dpung 'joms shing / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal dang ldan gyur pas/ sna tshogs grub mtha'i 'thibs po gcod mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan mkhas pa'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ skye dang skye bar sbyangs pa'i stobs sad pas/ /mkhas dang mkhas pa'i skyes bu mang bsten nas/ /lung dang rigs pa'i gzhung dang man ngag la/ /bslab dang legs par bslab tshul shas tsam brjod/ /bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa bslab gsum gyi dri ngad kyis nyes spyod kyi rnyog dug sel zhing / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas/ skyes bu mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa/ thugs dam gyi lhas byin gyis brlabs pas/ 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gri zhes phyogs thams cad du grags pa de nyid/ 'dzam bu'i gling byang gi cha la nye ba/ kha ba can gyi yul gyis dbus/ rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin las bod kyi skye bo thams cad dang por byung zhing / dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa'i gnas/ 'bru bcud phun sum tshogs shing / yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu dang / rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas pas mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'dzin pa/ skye bo thams cad ya rabs kyi tshul la gnas shing / bde bar gshegs pa'i sku dpag tu med pa rang byon du byon nas rnam par rgyal ba'i tshang bzang pas lhag pa'i gnas su bzhugs nas 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad pa'i gnas yar lung / de'i bye brag phu thang byang pa sar/ yab yon bdag 'khor lo 'bum dang / yum rnal 'byor rgyan ces pa/ yab de yul gyi gtso bor gyur cing / 'byor pa dang ldan par yod pa las/ pha spun yon bdag mkha' 'gros spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig pa'i sku gcig bzhengs pas/ rab gnas la yid gnyis su gyur nas/

paṇa chen shākya shrī spyan drangs pas de'i khang par ma byon zhing yon bdag 'khor lo 'bum gyi khang par byon te zhag gnyis su bzhugs nas/ dus phyis khyed la bu bzang po bstan pa la phan pa zhig 'byung bar 'dug ces lung bstan cing / de'i rjes nas bu che ba rnal 'byor 'bum zhes pa dang / gzung dar/ bsod nams dar/ bcom ldan pa dang / dge bshes sher smon dang lnga bcas pa las/ bcom ldan pa nyid dang po nas mi dge ba la ngang gis 'dzem zhing / 'chad nyan la sogs pa'i tshul la 'jug pa/ chos dang gang zag dam pa'i gtam 'ba' zhig gleng ba zhig byung bas yon btsun 'bum dkon zhes pa la klog legs par mthar phyin par bslabs shing phyis kyang ring du bsten nas/ rnam 'joms slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i 'grel pa/ sgrub thabs rig sngags 'chang gi slob dpon gzhon nu sde yis byas pa'i khrus chog smri ti'i lugs kyi 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs cha tshang ba/ kha che paṇa chen nas kyis yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs 'pho ba'i man ngag dang bcas pa/ rgya kan ba nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag bal po kā ya shrī'i chos gsum/ dmar po zhabs kyi rlung gi man ngag che chung / phyag rdor 'gro bzang ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud rdo rje sa gsum du rgyu ba'i rtog pa/ lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub thabs dang / kha rag skor gsum la sogs pa mang du gsan zhing dgung lo bcu gcig lon dus su kyi ston nam mkha' khyung la/ phur pa la sogs pa'i sgrub skor zhus nas de'i sgrub thabs dang / 'phrin chog dang / chab gtor 'jam dpal ma la sogs pa zhus so/ /de nas dgung lo bcu gnyis lon pa la gra byi gnas gsar du sgro rgyal mtshan thar zhes pa/ gtsang pa drug po la phar phyin la sogs pa'i chos mang du tshar ba/ gzhan yang yon tan du mas thugs rgyud gtams pa zhig gis mkhan po mdzad cing / phar phyin gnyal tig kyang gsan/ rgya kan pa'i gdung brgyud shākya seng ge zhes pa/

dpyal lo tswa ba dang / jo btsun rtags pa la sogs pa la slob gnyer mdzad cing gtsang du yun ring du bzhugs pas slob dpon gtsang pa zhes grags pa des slob dpon mdzad cing rab tu byung nas mtshan yang dar ma rgyal mtshan du btags so/ /de nas kyog ston dar ma grags zhes pa gnyal pa zhig po'i slob ma gcig la yi ge legs par bslabs shing / gnyal zhig gi tshad ma bsdus pa'ang gsan no/ /de nas gra bya'i lcags rir bzhugs nas 'dul 'dzin dpal bzang zhes pa la sha mi'i lugs kyi 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba dang / sum brgya pa dang / so sor thar pa dang / kā ri kā lnga bcu pa dang / bka' gdams nag tsho'i bstan rim dang / byang chub lam sgron dang / jo bo'i bden gnyis dang dbu ma'i man ngag dang / spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma dang / yan lag bdun pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi man ngag dang / chab gtor dri med dang / jo bos mdzad pa'i chab gtor gzhan gcig dang / lam sgron gyi jo bo'i rang 'grel dang / dbu ma'i seng ges mdzad pa'i bden gnyis kyi 'grel pa dang / jo bo'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs dang / mdo kun las btus pa chen mo dang / lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga dang / yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs dang / sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dang / mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs rnams jo bos mdzad pa dang / dam tshig gsum bkod rnams dang / gtsug tor dri med kyi rtog pa dang / de'i 'grel pa slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa dang / 'di yon btsun 'bum dkon la gsan kyang gsung ngo / /nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs/ bde mchog lo i pa'i sgrub thabs dang / de'i bshad pa lo tsa ba rin chen bzang pos jo bo'i gsung la zin bris mdzad pa dang / spyod 'jug stod lung rgya dmar ba'i lugs dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa gsar rnying / sher snying gi sgrub thabs nags tsho'i lugs/

rten 'brel gyi mdo/ /pha rol du phyin pa'i rab gnas/ byams pa lha yul ma'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa mang du gsan no/ /zhang mtshal pa'i dngos slob ngam shod kyi slob dpon sgom 'jam zhes pa'i sgom chen gcig la/ te lo pa'i dwa ha dang / ba su ki'i klu gtor dang / bla ma bhe ro'i chos ci rigs pa dang / mgon po la sogs pa mtshal pa'i chos mang du zhus shing / dpon sum pa la/ dpal lha las babs pa'i mchod rten gyi chag tshad bslabs shing yab dang gnyis ka la rnam par snang mdzad kyi tshe sgrub zhus so/ /bla ma dā na shī la la bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang bka' mang du zhus shing / 'jam dpal dkar po dang / mi g.yo ba dkar po dang / sngon po pus btsugs dang / ri khrod lo ma can dang / e ka dzā ti dkar nag gi sgrub thabs dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi'i lugs kyi gsang 'dus lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ phag mo'i mngon rtogs snye ma/ sgom pa drug gi gzhung / dha ri ka pa'i zhal gnyis ma'i 'grel pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi cha lag la sogs pa sngags kyi sgrub thabs dang / dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud dang / glegs bam bklag pa'i thabs/ a bhya'i lugs kyi klu gtor/ gzhan yang sgra'i 'god tshul dang / dbri bsnan/ yi ge'i brjod tshul la sogs pa dang / tshad ma'i gzhung ci rigs pa dang / sgeg pa rdo rje'i 'dzam nag 'brel gtam drir 'jug la sogs pa mang po'i sgo nas gtan la phab bo/ /slob dpon phu thang ston shag la gzhung rnam nges chos mchog che chung rigs thigs/ rgyud gzhan grub pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa/ tshad ma bsdus pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa/ phyi rol don grub/ tshad ma kun las btus/ tshad ma brtag pa che chung / gzhan sel/ smra sgo mtshon cha rig pa bklag pa/ yi ge'i mdo/ /dbang phyug rtag pa/ klu mes kyi bsdus chung / nor rgyun dkar dmar ser gsum gyi sgrub thabs/

bde mchog lo i pa dang / la ba pa'i 'grel pa dang / bde mchog gi rgyud 'grel ci rigs pa dang / gsang 'dus kun snying gi 'grel pa chung ba dang / ind+ra bo dhi'i gcig gsum pa'i cha lag ci rigs pa dang / ye shes zhabs lugs kyi cha lag ci rigs pa dang / gshin rje gshed dmar po'i lha bcu gsum ma dang / birwa pa'i lha lnga ma'i sgrub thabs dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dang / gtor chog 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga la sogs pa mang du gsan zhing sgra dang tshad ma'i srol dang grub mtha' rnam par dag pa rnams de las byung ngo / /slob dpon shī la shrī zhes pa sā dhu kīrti'i pan chung g.ye na bzhugs pa gcig la/ ka lā pa'i mtshams sbyor gyi rab tu byed pa le'u drug dang / rgya klog dang / rgya yig dang / sgra'i 'god tshul la sogs pa ci rigs pa bslabs so/ /paṇḍi ta shu bha ka ra se la yang sgra'i sbyor ba dang / yi ge'i bye brag dang / man ngag ci rigs pa zhus so/ /bla ma chag lo tswa ba chos rje dpal la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa slob dpon klu sgrub dang / klu'i byang chub gnyis char gyi dkyil 'khor cho ga nyi shu pa'i sgor dbang bskur ba zhus nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma 'grel pa sgron gsal/ sgrub thabs mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ dkyil 'khor cho ga nyi shu pa/ klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga rim lnga spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron me/ mngon par byang chub pa/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa/ las kyi mtha' rnam 'byed/ rgyan bdun dgrol ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ dus 'khor gyi bstan rtsis/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas/ rgyud sdom pa 'byung ba/ de'i 'grel pa ratna rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs dkyil chog dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba phal cher rdzogs par zhus nas dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi phreng ba/

sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma/ ngan song sbyong ba dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang zhus nas/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rdo rje 'byung ba/ a bhya'i lugs kyi sems bskyed zhus nas/ byang chub gzhung lam dang / sdom pa bzung ba'i cho ga bslab bya/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang / zhi ba'i lha la sogs pa'i sems bskyed zhus shing de'i cho ga dang bslab bya la sogs pa'i gzhung mang po/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo/ /'grel pa grags pa'i phreng ba/ 'dul ba me tog gi phreng rgyud/ dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi mdo/ /kā ri kā'i 'grel pa don brgyad ma/ bi bu ta'i sdom gsum 'od kyi phreng ba/ buddha shrī'i rgyal ba lam 'jug spyod 'jug buddha shrī'i lam rim/ shākya shrī'i lam rim/ shākya shrī'i yan lag bdun pa/ theg chen gyi smon lam/ a bhya'i 'dzam nag des mdzad pa'i sdom bzung ba'i cho ga mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa bdud rtsi thigs pa/ gur gum gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sha sha dha ra'i bstod pa/ sgrol ma'i me tog phreng 'dzin/ bzang po drug gi rab gnas/ shākya shrī'i theg chen gyi man ngag tshigs bcad ma/ bi bu ta'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgrub thabs/ sa bdag lto 'phye'i rtag pa/ kun rig la brten nas sdig pa sbyong thabs bcu gcig bde mchog lus dkyil la bsgom/ dril bu skor gsum/ dril bu pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes/ ltung ba'i snye ma dam tshig gso ba dang bcas pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ rnam par snang mdzad srung bas mdzad pa/ birwa pas mdzad pa'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ lhan skyes kyi sgrub pa/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'i cho ga maṇḍal gyi cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga bal po re bent+res mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gyi lugs cha lag tshang ba/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu gsum gyi cho ga

slob dpon gyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga rgyas pa slob dpon blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa byang chub snying pos mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi de kho na nyid/ 'chi bdag gi dbyug pa 'dzin pa'i rnam rgyal dang / de'i cha lag legs par tshang ba dang / ngan 'gro yongs su sbyong ba'i rnam rgyal la sogs pa gsan no/ /chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta la/ tshad ma rigs gter/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ tshogs chos/ sems bskyed/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgom don rnams thob/ dbyar nyi ma la mkhan po dang / mkhan chen mchims kha las chog dang / kyi ston gyis gsang ston byas nas dga' ba stong du bsnyen par rdzogs shing / dbyar nyi ma brtson 'grus las pha rol du phyin pa mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel/ nyi khri le brgyad ma/ nyi khri snang ba brgyad stong pa rtsa 'grel/ sdud pa rtsa 'grel/ sher snying rtsa 'grel/ yi ge gcig ma'i mdo man ngag dang bcas pa/ rkyang thur mtshur gyi tshad ma bsdus pa/ phyag rgya chen po brda' rgyab rten dang bcas pa/ gcod kyi man ngag rgya bug gi lam rim/ nā ro'i chos drug 'jam dpal dkar po la sogs pa zhus so/ /snar thang gi sangs rgyas bsgom pa la phar phyir gtong btsan ma dang / gtsang nag pa'i chos chung brgya rtsa dang / byang chub lam sgron dang / skyes bu gsum/ skyer sgang ma/ blo sbyong la sogs pa zhus so/ /mkhan chen mchims pa la/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ rgya che 'grel pa/ 'dul ba 'od ldan/ so sor thar pa/ sum brgya pa/ kā ri kā bka' gdams lam rim lam sgron/ bslab btus/ spyod 'jug mdo kun las btus/ skyes rabs/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ mngon pa mdzod/ mdzod kyi 'grel pa/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga/ theg bsdus bskor gsum/ rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud cho ga dang bcas pa/ kri ya dpung bzang / gsang ba spyi rgyud legs par grub pa'i rgyud/

bsam gtan phyi ma jo bo'i lugs kyi bde mchog dang / rje btsun ma'i cho ga zhus nas/ lu i pa'i sgrub thabs/ lha bcu gsum ma/ lha lnga ma/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ jo bos mdzad pa'i drug cu rtsa gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ lu i pa'i 'grel pa/ lta ba dang spyod pa'i glu'i 'grel pa/ lta sgom spyod gsum/ rje btsun ma rin chen rgyan gyi sgrub thabs cha lag dang bcas pa/ ba rang ma dang / rtswa'i spyil po ma dang / nā ro pas mdzad pa'i zhal gcig ma rdo rje bsnams pa'i sgrub thabs dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa dang / 'jam dpal smra seng / dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ /klu dbang rgyal po/ rta mgrin/ sman bla'i chos skor thams cad tshang ba/ zan mgo gcod thabs/ yan lag bdun pa/ chos spyod sil bu ci rigs pa/ sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs sgrub yig dang bcas pa/ sher snying gi sgrub pa/ mdo sde'i rgyan rtsa 'grel/ rgyud bla ma mngon rtogs rgyan/ dbus mtha'/ chos nyid rnam 'byed/ rten 'brel chen po'i ṭī ka las grub pa'i rab tu byed pa/ rnam bshad rig pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u dang / de'i sgrub thabs dang / phyag na rdo rje mtshan brgyad pa'i man ngag la sogs pa zhus so/ /slob dpon chu mig pa la/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub la gsol ba 'debs pa'i thabs/ jo bos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig zhus so/ /slob dpon skyel grags pa seng ge la/ tshad ma rnam par nges pa/ tshad ma bsdus pa/ rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa stong phrag phyed dang bzhi pa dang sde phran ci rigs pa gsan no/ /slob dpon kyi ston grags 'bum la chos mngon pa kun las btus pa dang / tshad ma rnam par nges pa dang / tshad ma bsdus pa la sogs pa gsan no/ /slob dpon 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge la/ tshad ma rnam 'grel dang / tshad ma mdo dang / rigs thigs dang / rgyud gzhan grub pa dang / 'brel ba brtag pa dang /

gtan tshigs thigs pa dang / rtsod rigs dang / rgyud brtag pa gnyis dang / rdo rje gur dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang / yan lag drug pa dang / dkyil 'khor cho ga bzang po yongs bzung dang / rin chen 'bar ba dang / bde mchog lu i pa'i skor dang / nag po'i chos drug dang / dril bu skor gsum dang / gdams ngag lam 'bras lam skor dang bcas pa dang / bir wa pa'i bsrung 'khor dang / rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang / ba ri ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / dgon par gnas pa'i chos drug dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma dang / tshad ma rigs gter dang / rigs pa grub pa dang / gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi gzungs shu rang ga warma'i 'grel par bcas pa dang / rdo rje gdan pa'i nye bar bshad pa dang / ghi ra warti dang / tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / ba ri ba'i gtor chen dang / rnam rgyal dang / 'brog mis bsgyur ba'i ngag dgrol la sogs pa gsan no/ /slob dpon do pa dkar shākya grags la gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ sgrol ma lus dkyil dang / mi g.yo ba la sogs pa'i chos skor 'ga' zhus so/ /slob dpon gad pa grags tshul la/ rda ra tra se na'i ru grags pa'i 'bum ṭīka 'bum ṭīka chen po'i phyed tsam/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab/ rtsod pa bzlog pa/ stong nyid bdun cu pa/ rigs pa drug cu pa/ zhib mo rnam par 'thag pa/ rin chen phreng ba/ rtsa ba'i 'grel pa tshig gsal 'jug pa rtsa 'grel/ rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa/ stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa/ rtsod zlog gi 'grel pa/ zhib mo rnam 'thag gi 'grel pa/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i dbu ma'i phung po lnga pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i dbu ma yi ge brgya pa rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma snang ba/ bden gnyis rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel/ sgom rim rnam pa gsum/

ka ma la shī la'i sgom rim/ mdor bsdus te sgom pa'i man ngag shanti pa'i dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa/ don dam par bstod pa/ dpe med par bstod pa/ mtha' las 'das par bstod pa/ rnam par mi rtog par bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa rtsa 'grel/ gnas chen po brgyad la bstod pa/ sems mgu bar bya bar bstod pa/ dmyal ba nas 'don par bstod pa/ sku gsum la bstod pa/ jo bo'i bden chung rtsa 'grel la sogs pa dbu ma'i gzhung rab tu mang po gsan no/ /bla ma gru rdo rje seng ge la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rgyud phyi ma/ tha ka na'i 'grel pa/ 'jam dpal zhal lung / sgrub thabs kun bzang / dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa/ grol ba'i thig le/ bdag sgrub par 'byung ba/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od/ sa du su dra'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ 'grel chung / dus zhabs kyi sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog yi ge'i rgyud de nyid 'dus pa/ kun snying gi 'grel pa de nyid snang ba/ shākya bshes gnyen gyi ko sa la'i rgyan/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i a ba ta ra/ rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ dpal mchog dang po'i rtsa 'grel/ rdo rje 'byung ba gtsug tor dgu pa dbang bka' dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor bskyangs kyi sbyin sreg dang sa tshwa/ dpal mchog rigs bsdus dang / rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dbang ka bde mchog le chung lugs kyi rtsa rgyud/ kun spyod lu i pa/ rtag pa rdo rje'i chos bzhi/ phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud rdo rje sa 'og gnod sbyin shing rta/ gar mkhan mchog rnam sras bde byed dang / drag po byed/ sems nyid ngal gso/ bstan pa'i gru/ sbas pa'i bum 'khyil/ shes rab 'khor lo/ /'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud/

rgyud phyi ma/ sgrub thabs 'khor lo chen po/ bdud rtsi thigs pa/ sgrub thabs mdor bsdus/ drag po gsum 'dul gyi 'grel pa/ bdud rtsi myu gu/ dkyil 'khor cho ga rim pa drug pa/ rtags gsal ba/ klu rigs bzhi sgrub pa'i thabs/ gnod sbyin gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ bdud rtsi bzlog pa/ sbyin sreg cho ga rgyas pa/ bsdus pa/ khro bo bsad pa'i phrin las/ mdze nad kyi mtshan nyid/ klu rigs bzhi bsad pa mnan pa/ gso ba'i cho ga phyag rdor mchod pa'i cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brjod/ de'i 'grel pa/ sgrub thabs dkyil chog rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs/ 'grel pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ dkyil chog rin chen snang ba/ sgrub thabs la sogs pa'i yan lag tshang ba/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs/ spyan ras gzigs pad ma cod pan/ mi g.yo ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po grub snying / rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ mtshan brjod phyag rgya chen po'i bshad lugs/ mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ las tshogs la sogs pa tshang ba/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs kyi dbang dang / rjes gnang dang / dmigs pa rnams tshang bar zhus nas gzungs kyi rgyud chung dang / sgrub thabs la dgu la ṭī ka chen mo btab pa/ mngon rtogs chen mo/ /chung ngu / lha lnga ma/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ gzungs kyi 'grel pa/ gtor ma/ sbyin sreg rta gtor/ nye bar bsnyen pa/ dngos grub nye bar byed pa/ jo bos mdzad pa'i klu mchod/ zhus lan gsum/ lam brtag pa/ tshod 'dzin dang bcas pa'i man ngag tshang ba/ si ti'i sbrul 'byin/ klu gtor chen mo/ /rnal 'byor brgyad pa sgyu 'phrul dang / sems phyogs ci rigs pa/ mā hā ma ya'i rgyud/ ku ku ri pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che chung dkyil chog de kho na nyid kyi rtsa 'grel la sogs pa'i phran bu rnams 'grel pa dang / cha lag gzhan ci rigs pa la sogs pa zhus so/ /bla ma dpyal a mo gha la dgyes rdor/ nā ro 'grel chen/

de'i man ngag rin po che sgrom gyi lde mig dgyes rdor gyi dkyil chog ngag 'don ma/ dgyes rdor lhan skyes/ bde mchog lhan skyes/ phag mo gzhung drug man ngag dang bcas pa/ sbyin sreg kur ma swa ta/ mkha' spyod ma/ de'i man ngag yid pham pa dang sems ngal gso ba dang / seng ge sgra/ rim lnga'i khrid/ sbyor drug gi man ngag bu bhu ta las brgyud pa/ phag mo lhan cig skyes pa/ bde mchog dkar po la sogs pa zhus so/ /rong yul ba dgon pa'i slob dpon jo gdan la/ dwa ha skor gsum/ dam pa dwa ha'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon thar pa'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ kha che paṇa chen nas kyi me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs/ 'pho ba/ bkra shis brgyad pa'o/ /drang po lung gi slob dpon thugs rje rgyal mtshan pa la/ don zhags dang / bcu gcig zhal gyi chos skor tshang ba dang / ba ri lugs kyi rnam rgyal dang / rnam rgyal shākya thub ma la sogs pa dang jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa'o/ /slob dpon 'phags pa la jo bo rje'i lugs kyi sbyor drug dang / gzhan yang gdams ngag ci rigs pa zhus so/ /nyang stod rma bya ras chen la bskyed rim jo mo lhan skyes/ rdzogs rim rlung sems dbyer med/ 'pho ba thig le sngo dmar zhes pa la sogs pa'i man ngag zab pa ci rigs pa dang / dgyes rdo rjer rngog pa'i lugs dang / bdag med ma'i dbang bka' dang / sgrub thabs dang / dgyes rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog gtum mo'i man ngag la sogs pa zhus so/ /bya yul gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshe ring po ba la slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong pa'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa gsan no/ /de rnams ni bdag gi blo snang ba rnams bris pa yin la gzhan yang der ma 'dus pa'i bla ma bsten pa dang / chos btsal ba'i tshul du ma yod mod kyi/ bdag gi nges pa ma rnyed pas mod la shas cher 'dzin pa'i blo ni sgro skur gyis yul can du dogs pas ma bris so/

/gzhan yang bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bzung zhing thugs dam gyis lha yis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul mtha' yas pa yod mod kyi snar thang du bzhugs dus su nag po tshang gi shar skya'i yi ge la gzigs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas sgom pa byon nas dbu la phyag gis byugs te dbus pa'i btsun chung mgo bo che 'di la dus phyis bstan pa la phan pa cig 'ong bar 'dug gis gsungs pa dang / chos nyan 'phro la gdon gyis rtog pa byung nas spangs rtsa ba la bstan pas lung ma byung ba dang / sangs rgyas bsgom pa'i gsung gis 'di la lung phog lo sum cu rtsa gnyis lon nas bstan pa'i bya ba chen po nus par yod gsung ba la phog ste grog po shar gyi gad phug tu bzhugs nas nyin bar nan tan dang / mtshan mo bzlas pa byas te/ gting nas gru pa la gtan pas bogs chen po byung nas 'dug gsungs nas dmigs pa legs par tshud de/ phyag na rdo rje la nus pa thon pa dang / lha sa'i steng gang gi mi g.yo ba dkar po la gsol ba btab cing bzlas pa byas pas dag snang khyad par can byung ba dang / phyis bzlas pa dung phyur lhag tsam byas pas mi g.yo ba pus mo dang zhabs kyi mthe bong nyi ma'i gdan la reg pa zhal gzigs pa dang / sngar chu mig tu rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas blo sna bstung dus bde mo mi yong zer ba'i snang ba byung ba'i rjes su hor byung nas mi mang po bsad pa byung ba dang / gzhan yang sku gzugs dang glegs bam gyi rab gnas byas pa la me tog gi phreng ba chags pa mang du byung ba la sogs pa mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya cher mnga' ba'i rgyu mtshan mang du yod mod kyi/ bla ma nyid kyang zhib par mi gsungs la/ bdag gis kyang sgro skur du dogs pa rnams ma bris so/ /nges par gsan pa'i gtan tshigs yod cing / gang las thos ma nges pa ni/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ a bhi dha na/ he ru ka mngon byung / ra lo'i rgyud rnams/

phag mo mngon 'byung / mkha' 'gro ma bzhi kha sbyor/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ phyag na rdo rje'i sbyor drug ye shes zhabs kyi sbyor drug rnam 'joms shol po lugs/ man ngag chos skor dang bcas pa/ bram ze mchog sred kyis byas pa'i mgon po gri gug gi sgrub thabs gnyis/ phyag bzhi pa'i skor rgyas pa/ rta mgrin drag po gsum 'dul/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa/ sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i le'u dang po/ jo bo dang 'di mi 'khrugs pa rigs pa grub pa'i sgron me/ gshin rje gshed nag 'jigs/ spring yig bdud rtsi'i thig le/ thams cad mkhyen pa grub par bstod pa/ sku'i phyogs gcig la bstod pa/ ljags la bstod pa/ tshems la bstod pa/ spel mar bstod pa/ lha las phul du byung bar bstod pa rtsa 'grel/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa rtsa 'grel/ phag mo gru pa'i zhi byed rmi lam ma/ rta dbyangs kyi dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa/ dus 'khor gyi rtsis/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs pa gsan par nges shing phal che ba sngar gyi slob dpon de dag la gsan yang gang la gsan the tshom can rnams ni bye brag tu ma phye bar bzhag cing / bdag gis ma rtogs pa'i bla ma bsten pa dang / zab cing rgya che ba'i chos dka' bas btsal ba dang zas gos la ched du ma bzung zhing tsha grang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa chos kyi phyir khyad par du bsad nas/ 'chad nyan dang sgom sgrub la sogs pa bstan pa'i bya ba byas te/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad btang nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang thugs dam la brtson par mdzad cing / gzhung lugs chen po phal ba'i rnam bshad dang / rang gi bzhed gzhung 'chad pa'i bstan bcos rab tu mang po dang / sgrub thabs dang man ngag gi yi ge yang mtha' yas pa mdzad pa las rags rim smos na/ pha rol du phyin pa'i 'grel bshad mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi me tog la sogs pa byams pa'i chos lnga char gyi ṭī ka dang /

tshad ma kun las btus pa'i ṭī ka dang / rnam 'grel dang / rnam par nges pa rgyan gyi me tog la sogs pa rtog ge sde bdun gyi ṭī ka dang / chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i ṭī ka dang / mdzod kyi gnas dang po'i ṭī ka dang / spyod 'jug dang byang chub lam sgron dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa spyod phyogs kyi gzhung mang po'i ṭī ka dang / dgyes pa'i rdo rje rgyan gyi me tog dang / gzhan yang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / mahā ma ya dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / drag po gsum 'dul dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod la sogs pa rgyud sde mang po'i rnam bshad dang dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab dang / bzhi brgya pa la sogs pa dbu ma'i gzhung lugs kyi rnam bshad dang / stong phrag brgya pa dang / shes rab snying po dang / yi ge gcig ma dang / brgyad stong don bsdu dang / sems tsam brgyan dang / phyi rol don grub dang / gzhan sel dang / dbang phyug rtag pa dang / rdo rje rnam 'joms dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa la sogs pa mang po'i ṭī ka dang / sde bdun rgyan gyi me tog smra ba rgyan gyi me tog bslab gsum rgyan gyi me tog dang / dbu ma rgyan gyi me tog dang / skyes rabs rgyan gyi me tog dang / 'dul ba rgyan gyi me tog dang / 'dul ba kun las btus pa rgyan gyi me tog dang / mdo sde kun las btus pa rgyan gyi me tog dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa rgyan gyi me tog dang / bden bzhi rgyan gyi me tog dang / tshogs brgyad rgyan gyi me tog dang / bskal pa rgyan gyi me tog dang / rgyud sde rgyan gyi me tog dang / dkyil 'khor rgyan gyi me tog dang / sbyin sreg rgyan gyi me tog dang / tshogs 'khor rgyan gyi me tog dang / bsngo ba rgyan gyi me tog dang / mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa rgyan gyi me tog dang / rdo rje gdan rgyan gyi me tog dang /

lta ba'i phreng ba rgyan gyi me tog dang / grub mtha' rgyan gyi me tog dang / sems bskyed rgyan gyi me tog dang / lnga bsdus dang / gza' lnga rgyan gyi me tog dang / sangs rgyas stong gi mchod pa'i cho ga dang / gzhan yang sgrub thabs dang man ngag la ni/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs kyi gzungs dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas bshad pa'i gzungs dang / sgrub thabs chen mo lha dgu ma dang / 'khor lo chen po dang / de'i dkyil 'khor cho ga dang / sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs dang / rta mgrin jo bo'i lugs dang / klu dbang rgyal po dang / sman bla dang / mgon po gri gug ma dang / 'od zer can dang / seng ge sgra dang / gtsug tor dri med dang / rnam rgyal dang / don zhags dang / bcu gcig zhal dang / 'jam dpal smra seng dang / gur gum gzhon nu dang / phyag rdor 'gro bzang ma dang / rnam sras dang / rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad dang / gsang 'dus lha bcu gsum ma dang / sangs rgyas stong dang / sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga dang / byams pa dang / shākya thub pa la sogs dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs dang / bstod pa dang / mi g.yo ba la sogs pa thugs dam gyi lha du ma'i mngon rtogs dang / bstod pa la sogs pa'i yi ge mdzad cing / man ngag la'ang chos drug rgyan gyi me tog dang / phyag rgya chen po rgyan gyi me tog dang / sems nyid ngal gso'i cha lag dang / sbyor drug la sogs pa'i gdams ngag du ma yod mod kyi mtha' yas pas mdzad yig nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang sa skya lo tsa ba'i gshegs rdzong gi chos 'khor la/ bo dong rin po che 'khor mang po dang bcas pa'i rgol ba rnams sun phyung nas/ chu mig ring mor rgyal po go pe la rgyal sar thon pa'i chos 'khor dang / 'ji bi gi chos 'khor dang / jing kyim gyi chos 'khor dang / bla ma chen po 'phags pa'i gshegs rdzong gi chos 'khor dang / sa skyar slob dpon phyag na'i chos 'khor dang /

dpon chen shākya bzang po'i gshegs rdzong dang / slob dpon dharma pā la ra ta'i chos 'khor la sogs pa dge 'dun 'du ba chen po thams cad kyi tshe'ang rtsod pa'i seng ge'i nga ros rgol ba glang po'i dregs pa thams cad bcom ste/ yang dag pa'i rtog ge la thams cad 'dun par byas shing / sngar dgung lo sum cu so gnyis gsum nas thang po che dang / lhag ru la sogs par pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshad ma bsdus pa dang / mngon pa mdzod la sogs pa'i gzhung lugs mang du gsungs shing / dgung lo so drug pa'i dus su snar thang du slob dpon gyi ston grags 'bum sku 'das nas de'i gdan sa dang / gzhan yang theg pa che chung gi sde snod dang / rgyud sde dang / sgra tshad dang / man ngag la sogs pa'i chos kyi tshul sna tshogs gsal bar mdzad par dgongs nas/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang / nye gnas chen po chos kyi byang chub kyi gsung dang bu slob rnams kyis zhu ba bskur ba la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam sgeg dang / dge bshes 'bum me dang / 'bri sgang pa gzhon rdor rnams kyis spyan drangs te/ chu pho khyi'i lo la chags phab nas shing mo sbrul gyi bar du lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhir dpal ldan snar thang gis gtso byas pa'i chos gzhis chu mig ring mo dang / zha lu gser khang dang / shab sna ring dang / thang skya dang / glas ring la sogs par yang skabs su byon nas pha rol du phyin pa dang / mngon pa kun las btus dang / tshad ma rnam nges dang bsdus pa la sogs pa dus bzhir rgyun ma chad par gsungs shing / gzhan yang sde snod/ rgyud sde/ sgra tshad/ man ngag la sogs pa'i chos kyi char phab cing / slob ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa smin pa dang grol bar mdzad de/ sde snod 'dzin pa stong phrag lhag pa thon cing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'gro ba'i gsos sman du gyur pa'ang lnga brgya lhag byung ngo / /de ltar 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad nas 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid la rmongs pa rnams la de'i tshul gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/

drung na bzhugs pa'i zhabs thog byed pa kun dang / nye ba na gnas pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa dbu tshad pa rin chen bzang po dang / dbus pa blo gsal rtsod pa'i seng ge la sogs pa la bos nas/ kha ba can gyi yul 'dir lung rigs la blo sbyangs pa dang / rtog ge'i tshul smra ba mang du byung mod kyi lo rtsa ba chen po'i shes rab la 'gran par nus pa med cing de'i grub mtha' la nor ba med kyang de'i rjes nas nor ba'i grub mtha' mang du byung bas de dag gi rjes su ma 'jug par/ paṇa chen sbyin pa tshul khrims kyi rjes su 'brang pa la'ang grub mtha' rtsing por smra ba yod mod kyi/ gzhung gi dgongs pa la sgrig pa mang po'ang med mod/ de dag dang yang ma 'dres par rang lugs kyi grub mtha' rnam par dag pa bzung la bstan pa'i bya ba gyis zhes pa la sogs pa zhal chems su gsungs nas shing mo sbrul gyi lo dus 'khor lugs kyi ston zla ra ba/ khrum gyi zla ba'i tshes dgu'i snga dro nyi ma shar gting la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs so/ /tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin mo tsan dan dang a ka ru las byas pa'i zhugs shing dri zhim po du ma'i zhugs me phul bas rtsa ro rkyang dbu ma gsum me lhas ma gsol bar byin pa dang / sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can du byon pa dang / nam mkha' la 'ja'i gur phub pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung zhing bu slob phyogs mtshams nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa du ma 'dus nas gsol ba btab ste/ sku gdung phal che ba ni mchod rten byang chub chen po rgyu sman dang dar zab las grub cing kha dog ser la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i nang du bzhugs shing / bu slob dad pa can rnams kyis phyogs mtshams su ci rigs pa spyan drangs te/ sku gzugs du ma bzhengs nas sku gdung gi snying po can du byas so/ /de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyang mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po'i bdag rkyen la brten nas spyir bsdoms ste bzhengs nas snar thang gi gzim khang du bzhugs pa dang /

so sor bzhengs te yul phyogs tha dad par spyan drangs nas bstan pa'i snying por bzhugs nas kyang yun du bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i sgo nas don chen por gyur to/ /bu slob sde snod 'dzin pa mtshan mo'i skar tshogs tsam gyis kyang nyid las thob pa'i sde snod dang / rgyud sde dang / sgra tshad/ man ngag rnams la brten nas 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa dang / sgom pa'i sgo nas 'phrin las kyi rgyun gyis bstan pa'i bya ba cher grub pa dang / 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ thog med dus nas sbyangs pa mthar son cing / /dam pas lung bstan yul dbus sa'i mthil/ /mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas yar lung phu thang du/ /bltams pa'i mdzad pa bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i dus na legs spyad goms pa'i mthus/ /dkar nag las la blang dor ngang gis mdzad/ /rnam bcu'i spyod la brtse ba'i tshul mdzad pas/ /ma gos dri ma spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams mi gtsang ltar gzigs nas/ /bcu gnyis lo la bya gri gnas gsal du/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dar phyir shākya'i/ /seng ge'i bstan la zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo paṇa mkhas grub lung rtogs ldan pa yid/ /'dren pa bcu phrag gsum la gus bsten cing / /sgra tshad lung rigs man ngag kun sbyangs pas/ /gnas lnga mthar phyin gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas mchog gyur nas dga' sdong gtsug lag tu/ /nyi ma nam mkha' grags pa'i zhabs drung du/ /mngon du gyur pa bcu yi rgyu tshogs las/ /rnam dag bsnyen par rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ting 'dzin gsal ldan pas/ /klu sogs gdon bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu ldan zhing / /sgrol ma mi g.yo mgon gyi rjes bzung bas/ /grub mchog khyad par can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu sgrub thogs med zhabs dang zhi ba'i lha/ /'jig med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i shing rta'i srol/ /smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/

/'gro don skyo med mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /paṇa chen dā na shī la chos rje chag /grub chen rdo rje seng ge a mo gha/ /rnam dag rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu'i lo la sa skya paṇḍi ta'i/ /chos 'khor mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i tshe/ /bo dong rin chen 'khor mang bcas la sogs/ /kun las rnam par rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so gnyis lo nas thang chen lhag ru sogs/ /sde chen rgya mtsho'i 'dren par gyur nas ni/ /pha rol phyin gzhung mdzod dang bsdus pa yis/ /'khor lo thog mar bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so drug chu pho khyi yi ston ka nas/ /don dgu shing mo sbrul gyi ston ser bar/ /dam pas bsngags pas gdan sa snar thang du/ /thog mtha' bar gsum dge ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /dri med chos char phab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar rgya nag kha che bal bod dang / /sing gha gling dang zangs gling u rgyan dang / /mi nyag yu gur la sogs dkar po'i yul/ /kun gyi tshad mar bkur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi dbang sras dang 'dren par bcas pa yi/ /khrims ldan 'bum dang mkhas pa khri phrag la/ /chos 'khor bskor tshe rgol ba glang po'i tshogs/ /seng ge'i nga ros bcom la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang mkhas pa'i bstan bcos dang / /dam pa'i gsung gi gdams ngag zab mo'i don/ /sdeb legs tshig gis rnam par 'byed la mkhas/ /rtsom pa'i mchog tu gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi dbang dge ba'i bshes dang sde chen bdag /'byor ldan skye bos thod bzhin bkur gyur kyang / /chos 'dod zang zing med la mi brnyas pa/ /thugs rje kun la snyoms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe 'di'i 'dod yon rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /'khor dang longs spyod sprin ltar 'dus gyur kyang / /khengs dregs 'dod pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos par/ /'jig rten 'du 'dzi spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku nas byon dang bsnyun gyi zin tshe'ang /

/dbang po gsal zhing brtson pa'i shugs drag pas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang sgrub la g.yel med pa'i/ /mthu stobs bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'da' ba'i sngon du 'khor gyi mkhas tshogs la/ /log lta'i dri ma blo gros ma spangs par/ /rnam dag grub mtha'i bstan pa zungs shig ces/ /brtse bas gsungs chems bzhag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shing mo sbrul gyi khrum zla'i tshes dgu la/ /bstan pa rgyas byed bcom ldan pad mo'i gnyen/ /mi rtag sgra gcan 'dzin gyis zin par gyur/ /lta ngan mun pa'i dmag gis phyogs bcur khyab/ /kye ma kyi hud chos kyi sgron me mnal/ /kye ma kyi hud phan bde'i ljon shing skam/ /kye ma kye hud legs bshad char pa chad/ /kye ma kyi hud mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan stor/ /thub pa'i sku tsher gcig gis ma chog pas/ /sku yi gdul bya rdzogs nas bdag cag dor/ /gdung ba'i yid kyis phyogs bcur btsal byas kyang / /mthun pa'i dpe yang rnyed par ma gyur to/ /kye ma mkhas mchog zhi ba'i tshul bstan pas/ /da ni grub mtha' ngan pa'i tshang tshing 'khrigs/ /log pa'i bshes gnyen dregs pa'i nga ro 'byin/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi dgongs pa gang nas btsal/ /snyigs ma'i skye bo rigs lam mi 'jug cing / /bsags pa'i drin brgya tshig ngor 'dor ba'i tshe/ /bcom ldan rigs pa'i dbang phyug mi bzhugs na/ /legs pa'i lam nyid gang nas btsal bar bya/ /bshes gnyen chos min bya bas brel gyur cing / /dge sbyong 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba rnams/ /skyabs mchog dpa' bo khyod kyis ma bzung na/ /bde 'gro'i lam la gang gis 'dren par gyur/ /sde snod smra rnams rnyed dang bkur stis bcings/ /grags 'dod bdag bstod pha rol dmod pa rnams/ /blo gros chen po'i rnam thar ma mthong na/ /chos ltar bcos pa'i dri ma gang gis sel/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal kun bzang mchod tshogs 'bul/ /ma lus sdig bshags dge la rjes yid rang /

/'khor lo bskor zhing yun du bzhugs par gsol/ /dus gsum dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /mkhas mchog bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro ba'i gsos sman thub bstan pad mo'i tshal/ /ring nas phyogs bcur rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kyi gzhir gyur bstan rtsa gtsug lag khang / /rten gsum kun bzang mchod sprin gyis spras te/ /dge 'dun bdud kyis dbye bar mi nus shing / /chos spyod bcu yis rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ dkar po'i lha rnams dus su char 'bebs shing / /sa gzhi lo thog dri yis khyab gyur nas/ /nad dang 'thab rtsod med cing 'bru 'phel bas/ /skye dgu thams cad bde bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa'i skye bo rnams/ /'gro la phan bde'i bsam sbyor mi 'khrug cing / /bdud dang bgegs kyis bar chad mi nus pa/ /sku tshe yun du brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag kyang khyed kyi bstan pa rjes bzungs te/ /gsung rab nor bu spyi bos len pa la/ /las dang log 'dren gtum pos mi gnod par/ /don gnyis mthar phyin 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /legs tshogs rnam thar mthong bzhin bris pa dang / /bka' drin dran pa'i tshig gi bstod pa yis/ /rdo rje'i gdan drung mngon par sangs rgyas bar/ /mkhas pa de yi zhabs drung skye bar shog /thub chen 'od 'phro'i phung po rin chen snying / /bde gshegs dkon mchog yan lag mar me mdzad/ /'od srung shākya'i skyes mchog bkra shis kyis/ /tshogs rdzogs myur du 'tshang rgya'i bkra shis shog /'jam dbyangs rdo rje 'dzin dang byams pa'i mgon/ /mkha' snying sgrib rnam sel dang kun tu bzang / /sa snying 'jig rten dbang phyug bkra shis kyis/ /rgyal sras spyod mthar phyin pa'i bkra shis shog /'od srung kun dga' bo dang nye bar 'khor/ /dgra bcom bka' rgyud gsum dang gzhan yang ni/

/'phags chen gnas brtan bcu drug bkra shis kyis/ /thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /klu sgrub 'phags pa lha dang zla ba grags/ /thogs med dbyig gnyen zhabs dang blo gros brtan/ /phyogs glang dharma kīrti chos mchog gis/ /ma nor gsung rab 'byed pa'i bkra shis shog /dā na shi la dzi na mi tra dang / /'chi med gzhan phan ka cog zhang gsum dang / /rin bzang zangs rngog gnyan tshogs sbyangs stobs kyis/ /legs sbyar brda skad rnam dag bkra shis shog /blo ldan sras kyi thu bo rnam gnyis dang / /'bri khyung rgya dmar phya gtsang dan gsum dang / /gnyal zhig rigs pa'i seng ge skyel sogs kyis/ /rnam dag gzhung lugs smra ba'i bkra shis shog /bka' brgyud dri med mkha' 'dra'i byin rlabs dang / /bcom ldan rigs pa'i thugs rje'i nyi 'od dang / /mkhas mang rgyu skar bye ba'i phrin las kyis/ chos brgyud rnam par 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri'i rnam thar dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas mchog de nyid kyi dbon po bsod nams kyi lhun po shes rab kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mngon par mtho bas cung zad bskul ba'i ngor/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa bsam gtan bzang pos rang gi blo la snang ba rnams bris pa yin no/ /dge zhing bkra shis pa dang ldan par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri bcom ldan rig ral gyi rnam thar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
